review_evidence: README defines LeanFrontier as a normal Lean mathematical library whose ordinary submissions must be kernel-checked, contain no sorry/custom axioms, and satisfy an explicit theorem-submission contract.
31 of 33 Lean files in the hydrated source contain proposition declarations across dynamics, number theory, geometry, representation theory and analysis.
The receiver/maintenance machinery surrounds a substantive theorem corpus; the mathematical source itself is directly relevant formalization prior art.
summary: Reviewed LeanFrontier; retain its kernel-verified machine-generated mathematics corpus.

review_evidence: LeanFrontier.lean (5314 B): contains only import lines and a module docstring that names it the generated umbrella module. It is an import aggregator and FILTER-007 retains it.

tests/fixtures/receiver/BrokenFixture.lean (253 B), read completely: one theorem sq_add_sq_ne stating (a+b)^2 = a^2+b^2 over Z, deliberately false, as a receiver test fixture. It has a formal declaration, so it stays.
LeanFrontier/NumberTheory/MarkovTree/Symmetry.lean: defs branchPermState, branchPermMove, inverseBranch and theorem branchPermMove_injective about the cyclic symmetry of oriented Markov branches.
LeanFrontier/Probability/KochenStone.lean (13553 B): a Kochen-Stone lower bound for P(limsup A) built from the Chung-Erdos inequality, with helper defs firstSum, secondSum, ksRatio and tailUnion.
LeanFrontier/NumberTheory/A053067/ResidueOne.lean (28402 B, the largest file): fixedConcat recurrence with simp lemmas, map_fixedConcat and fixedConcat_one_eq_sum for OEIS A053067.
LeanFrontier/NumberTheory/DiscriminantTowerWitness.lean (21754 B): theorem coprimalityIsLoadBearing, which uses the sqrt 2 and sqrt -2 subfields of the eighth cyclotomic field as a witness.

Declaration grep: the smallest source files (Orthogonality 1404 B, Varignon 1515 B, Nesbitt 1678 B, Collision 1690 B) each hold one declaration. The md5 duplicate check over LeanFrontier/*.lean returned no duplicates. The sorry grep returned no hits.
summary: Surveyed all 76 listed files by path and byte size (253 to 28402 bytes). A per-file declaration grep found at least one Lean declaration in all 75 files except LeanFrontier.lean; 654 declarations across the 98 .lean files under LeanFrontier/. An md5 check found no byte-identical files, and a grep for sorry found none. Spot reads of MarkovTree/Symmetry, Probability/KochenStone, A053067/ResidueOne and DiscriminantTowerWitness show distinct, documented mathematics (Markov-tree symmetry, Kochen-Stone, OEIS A053067 concatenation, discriminants of quadratic subfields of the eighth cyclotomic field). None of this is boilerplate or garbled output. LeanFrontier.lean contains only imports and a module docstring, so FILTER-007 keeps it primary-eligible. tests/fixtures/receiver/BrokenFixture.lean holds one formal theorem statement, so it stays. All files stay.

summary: Inspected all 7 listed files. LeanFrontier.lean is a pure import aggregator (only imports + module docstring, zero declarations). The other 6 files each contain substantial formal mathematical content: LogisticTransitivity.lean proves topological transitivity of tent/logistic maps via pullback constructions; CyclotomicEightGalois.lean proves the Galois group of ℚ(ζ₈) is Klein four via Mathlib's cyclotomic equivalence; CyclotomicEightGaussian.lean constructs the Gaussian generator i = √2·√-2/2 inside CyclotomicEight and proves its minimal polynomial is X²+1; CyclotomicEightQuadraticClassification.lean uses Galois correspondence and projective-line cardinality to prove exactly 3 quadratic intermediate fields; DescartesCurvatureAction.lean bundles Descartes quadruples, defines indexed Vieta reflections as linear maps, and proves form preservation/involution; FurstenbergFiniteIndex.lean shows every finite-index normal additive subgroup of ℤ is nℤ with quotient ZMod n. All 6 mathematical files have multiple theorems/definitions. LeanFrontier.lean qualifies under FILTER-007 as import-only but the previous review (RRV-06e919455fef-r2) kept it primary-eligible because the auxiliary navigation channel is not verified end-to-end. Per FILTER-002's high evidence bar and FILTER-025's default of retain, no files meet the hard-exclusion threshold.
